purpose: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy and links back up it.

props.name: items
props.description: Trail from the top level to the current page (last item)

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapses longer trails to the first and last items with a Show full path button. Defaults to 4

whenToUse: On pages two or more levels deep
When users need to move up the hierarchy
antiPatterns: Using breadcrumbs for steps in a process

anatomy: Label-sized links separated by chevrons; the current page as plain text; a … button when collapsed

a11yNotes: The current page has aria-current page and is not a link
The collapse button is named Show full path
